ruleDefinitions.name: Potential Persistence Via Security Descriptors - ScriptBlock
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects usage of certain functions and keywords that are used to manipulate security descriptors in order to potentially set a backdoor. As seen used in the DAMP project. Note: Unmapped fields: ScriptBlockText

sequences.query: ((ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*win32\\_Trustee.*") AND ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*win32\\_Ace.*") AND ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\\.AccessMask.*") AND ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\\.AceType.*") AND ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\\.SetSecurityDescriptor.*")) AND (ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\\\Lsa\\\\JD.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\\\Lsa\\\\Skew1.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\\\Lsa\\\\Data.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\\\Lsa\\\\GBG.*")))
